blockers.name: Whole-source contextual validation
blockers.risk: Structural matching falsely accepts contextual-invalid source if treated as compilation validation. A naive pre-fold check also falsely rejects discarded declarations.
blockers.reason_unresolved: Matcher returns recognition/chart positions, not a declaration AST. Test forest uses host tokens, omits aggregate internals and has no scope/folding model. Token scans cannot identify targets or surviving declarations reliably.
blockers.release_impact: Grammar-complete package may ship with these external constraints. Repository-only whole-source validity and fully conformant claims prohibited.
blockers.future_work: Add repository-owned derivations with declaration/scope nodes, early actions, folding and explicit checked/unsupported rule results before extending source validation.
